description: The election vocabulary (REG-2): the voting systems an election or contest is counted by (an election bundle's votingSystem, data/elections-source/data/elections/) and the kinds of election (general or by-election), with the words the site shows for them. A value is added here before any data or code uses it. Schema: packages/registries/schemas/election-types.schema.json; views: packages/registries/src/election-types.mjs. The browser slice (packages/registries/src/browser/election-types.json) carries the names and labels to the Elections app (systemName) and Browse (the Type filter).

fptp.about: first past the post: the candidate with most votes wins each seat
fptp.name: first past the post

block-vote.about: each elector has as many votes as there are seats; the candidates with most votes win

stv-gregory.about: single transferable vote, transferring surpluses by the Gregory method (Northern Ireland, and the Seanad's vocational panels, whose ballot papers are each valued at 1,000)
stv-gregory.name: single transferable vote (Gregory method)

stv-hare.about: single transferable vote, transferring surpluses by a random sample of the last parcel (the Republic of Ireland)
stv-hare.name: single transferable vote

party-list-dhondt.about: a party list, seats allocated by the D'Hondt divisors
party-list-dhondt.name: party list (D'Hondt)

ordinal.about: a referendum: the options are counted, not candidates
ordinal.name: referendum

general.about: an election of the whole body (every seat, or a council's whole membership)

by-election.about: an election to fill one or more seats that fell vacant
